hooks.command: fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$fp" ] && exit 0; case "$fp" in *.ckpt|*.pt|*.pth|*/outputs/*|*/Checkpoints/*) echo "BLOCKED: $fp is a protected training artifact (ckpt or outputs/). If you really need to edit it, temporarily disable this hook in .claude/settings.json." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac; exit 0

fp=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$fp" ] && exit 0; case "$fp" in *.py) out=$(python3 -c "import ast,sys; ast.parse(open(sys.argv[1]).read(), filename=sys.argv[1])" "$fp" 2>&1) || { echo "Syntax error in $fp:" >&2; echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0
